name: Mob Drops Plus
summary: Husks, drowned, pillagers, foxes and other mobs that drop little now leave a small, fitting extra item when they die.
logoPrompt: A single open brown leather loot pouch with a little sand, a strand of green kelp and one arrow poking out of it, centred, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Small, fitting extra drops for ten mobs.
bullets: Sand from husks, kelp from drowned

description: **Mob Drops Plus gives ten mobs a small extra drop that suits them, from sand for husks to leather for camels and goats.**
- Husks drop sand, drowned a bit of kelp and pillagers arrows.
- Zoglins, ravagers, camels and goats drop leather.
- Foxes drop sweet berries, and ocelots drop string like cats do.
- Cave spiders sometimes leave a cobweb when a player kills them.
- Looting works as in vanilla, and every vanilla drop stays as it was.
Put the zip into the `datapacks` folder of your world (or pick it when you create a new world). Then play as usual; the new drops fall right away.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. Works in singleplayer and on servers; players need nothing installed.
- Only cheap, common items: no diamonds, gold, emeralds or other rare drops. At most two at a time, plus Looting.
- It changes the loot of these ten mobs, so another pack that changes the same mobs can override it or be overridden by it.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
